signature_rule: first two bytes equal ASCII BM (0x42 0x4d)
signature_rule_matches: CImageLoaderBMP::isALoadableFileFormat reads two bytes and compares the little-endian 16-bit value with 0x4d42
bmp_suffix_rule: case-sensitive substring tests for .bmp and .BMP; not suffix-only
scope_note: This census covers only regular files under the recovered cache extraction root. It does not establish that no other BMP data exists in unextracted containers or outside this cache.
